title: Agent benchmark task record
description: One frozen task, written by select_tasks.py draw and completed at freezing (TASKS.md). Fields under `hidden`, and `conventions`, are never shown to the agent. Only `prompt` reaches the agent.

id.description: Repository slug plus pull request number. Never shown to graders, who see packet ids only.

merge_commit.description: The commit that landed the change on the base branch (merge or squash commit).

base_commit.description: First parent of merge_commit: the base branch just before the change. The agent's working copy starts here and holds no later commit.

language.description: The language of most changed code files Drift reads.

raw_sha256.description: sha256 of the text "issue" + U+001F + title + U+001F + body, before stripping.

stripped.description: Every removal the stripping rule made (TASKS.md, 'The prompt'), in order.

prompt.description: Exactly what the agent receives: the spec's prompt_template filled with the stripped issue title and body. Identical in every arm.

changed_files.description: Paths the real change touched. For graders and the similarity check only.

reference_diff.description: Path, relative to the task directory, of the real change as a diff (base_commit to merge_commit), written by `harness.py freeze` from the local mirror. Null until frozen.

test_command.description: The repository's own test command for the touched code, run by the harness after the agent finishes, with a timeout. Taken from the repository's CI or contributing docs at base_commit, written before any run. Null when there is none or it cannot run offline.

setup_command.description: Command that makes test_command runnable (for example installing dependencies from a local cache), run before the arm is prepared. Null when not needed.

conventions.description: The conventions graders hold this task to, listed by the two graders from the real change and the repository at base_commit, never from Drift's output, and frozen before any run (RUBRIC.md, step 1).

text.description: One sentence a grader can check against a diff.

evidence.description: Files at base_commit (path or path:line) that show the convention.

rank.description: Position in the seeded order of all drawn tasks.
